findings.description: Round-1 fix introduced an ordering contradiction: D2's last bullet says all four existing contract tests (including skills/tests/supervise/test_execution_contract.py) validate through dispatch_contract, but task 2.3a assigns test_execution_contract.py to wp-dispatch-schemas, a root package that lands before wp-contract-lib creates skills/shared/dispatch_contract.py. Followed literally, wp-dispatch-schemas cannot pass its own edit.
findings.resolution: Re-verified resolved in round 3: D2 now keeps test_execution_contract.py on its own registry inside wp-dispatch-schemas and moves only test_execution.py (wp-supervisor), test_dispatch_scheduler.py and test_supervised_dispatch_e2e.py (wp-runtime-ledger) to dispatch_contract; matches work-packages.yaml write scopes.
